ZAF.note: The bank partnership is for smart ID applications and replacement, not remote authentication.
No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No statement on a number given at birth.
Who operates and owns the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Home Affairs issues and replaces smart ID cards, now at more than 500 bank branches through its partnership with Capitec, Standard Bank, FNB and Absa; the minister said more than half a million people had used the replacement service by August 2026.
